title: Differential row result (INTERFACE v1.2)
description: One result object per inventory row returned by run_inventory. Mirrors the v1.1 Row-result schema in /tmp/qubit-differential/INTERFACE.md plus the Plan section 8/15 evidence fields and the v1.2 transport/reference additions. v1.3 adds the optional voice result keys resolved_operation, confirmation_required and voice_detail, and the voice transport value. additionalProperties is intentionally open: results also carry runner bookkeeping such as qubit_payload, qubit_raw_result_hash and missing_evidence. The v1.2/v1.3 keys are optional (never required) because the runner only emits them on rows whose adapter exposes that transport/reference/voice evidence; the required list stays consistent with the runner.

state_changing.description: Whether the row's fixture was declared state_changing.

state_changing_skipped.description: True when a state_changing fixture was not executed because allow_state_changing was not opted in.

state_changing_reason.description: Optional. Why the row/fixture was classified state-changing, or why a state-changing row was skipped. Absent/null when not applicable.

host_allowlist_violation.description: Optional. True when a transport adapter attempted a host outside the env-derived allowlist (SSRF guard). Absent/null when no transport request executed.

redacted.description: Optional. True when secret-shaped values in this row's payload/detail were redacted before emission.

byte_parity.description: Whether the compared payloads matched byte-for-byte (before normalizers). Null when no byte-comparable payload exists.

resolved_operation.description: Optional. Canonical operation a voice/utterance row actually resolved to (the runner's voice_operation). Absent/null on non-voice rows or when unresolved.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. Whether the resolved voice operation staged a confirmation before execution. Absent/null when not applicable.

voice_detail.description: Optional. Additional voice evidence (identity, confirmation, cancel/expiry/replay detail). Absent/null when not applicable.

references.description: Per-project reference execution bookkeeping, keyed by hermes|openclaw. Always emitted ({} when none declared).

reference_provenance.description: INTERFACE v1.2 reference provenance: {<project>: {bin, version, commit, pinned}}.

reference_payloads.description: Raw (un-normalized) payload of each executed reference, keyed by project.

reference_determinism.description: Optional. Result of the reference determinism check for this row: whether it was checked, whether the reference is stable across runs, and why. Absent/null when the row declared no reference.

checked.description: True when the runner actually performed the determinism check.

stable.description: True when the reference payload is reproducible across runs (no unpinned nondeterminism detected).

reason.description: Why the reference is or is not considered stable; null/empty when no reason is recorded.

bin.description: Resolved binary path or URL (env-var-derived; never a secret).
